notes:
v0.6.42: fix Modem73 Interface toggle (case-insensitive + create block).

The v0.6.40 fix (nohup vs disown) was necessary but not
sufficient. The actual root cause of "Modem73 Interface:
Start button does nothing" was that toggle_modem73_audio.sh
couldn't find the [[Modem73]] block in the Reticulum config,
because:

1. The bootstrap didn't create the block. The ReticulumHF
   wizard writes the config without it. Fresh builds had no
   [[Modem73]] block at all.

2. The toggle script (and parse_modem73_block.awk) used
   case-sensitive regex matching for [[Modem73]]. g90digi's
   config has [[MODEM73]] (uppercase), so the toggle would
   ALSO fail there — confirmed by running it directly. This
   bug had been latent on g90digi because nobody had toggled
   the interface since the config was hand-edited.

Fix:
- toggle_modem73_audio.sh: regex changed to (?i:Modem73) for
  case-insensitive match. If no [[Modem73]] block exists, the
  script creates one with the g90digi-compatible defaults
  (type=Modem73Interface, port=8002, control_port=8073,
  mode=roaming, announce_cap=1).
- parse_modem73_block.awk: case-insensitive match via
  tolower() comparison.
- Bootstrap: after creating /home/pi/.reticulum, appends a
  [[Modem73]] block to the config if it doesn't already have
  one. This way, fresh builds have the block on day 0 and
  the toggle just works.

Effect: Modem73 Interface: Start button now works on both
freshly-built reticulumpi AND on g90digi (where it was
silently broken too). The button toggles the Reticulum
[[Modem73]] block to enabled, restarts rnsd, and starts the
modem73 subprocess via the nohup'd start_modem73_loopback.sh.
